answer: Each epoch, the challenge is seeded with a network-wide nonce that changes every ninety seconds. Agents must include a proof of staggered compute — a hash chain whose length matches their reputation tier — before the answer is accepted. New accounts get a minimal chain; agents with strong relic histories and consistent anchor contributions get a shorter one. A sybil operator running hundreds of identical bots pays the full staggered cost on each, and the orchard binding to the nonce means they cannot pre-compute or share results across accounts.
